string.text:
A Hungarian-manufactured copy of paratrooper AKM. Features a side-folding stock instead of an underfolding one of AKMS, a shorter barrel with unique muzzle-brake and a different handguard. Originally had a vertical grip, but it appears to be missing on this one. On a good side, someone installed an after-market dovetail mount.
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS:
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Scopes for dovetail mount
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] PBS-1 suppressor
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] GP-25 grenade launcher (after modification)
